Nydia Lodge turn-off to Kaiuma Bay (4 hr)
The track starts at the road end and carpark at Duncan Bay.
The track then climbs a little into the forest and sidles around to a point above Kaiuma Bay, before dropping to the car park.
Travel 21 km to the track start on the roadside marked with a large sign.

doubts: Start: F1 (Nydia Track meets Duncan Bay Road) is the road end and carpark at Duncan Bay. End: F3 (Nydia Track meets Kaiuma Bay Road) is taken as the Kaiuma car park, since the text says the track drops to the car park from above Kaiuma Bay and names the track; F4 (an unnamed track meets Kaiuma Bay Road) is about 500 m west and was not chosen. The text's 'car park' at Kaiuma is not otherwise named. Fords: the stream before the Nydia Lodge turn-off is stated to be forded; the stream crossed twice after the turn-off and the stream after Kaiuma Saddle are recorded as fords because the page describes unbridged crossings and no bridge is named there. The Nydia Lodge is a 30 min walk from the turn-off and is recorded as a side trip, not a hut on the way. The Shag Point and Nydia Bay boat access points do not say which track they join (Shag Point is 4 km from the track end at Kaiuma). The Tennyson Inlet view has no ref because two names of that inlet (T15 place, T16 coast) lie at different points. The Duncan Bay and Kaiuma distances are DOC's; the way's distance is copied from DOC's summary, not from a heading.
